diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.syncer is created before aws_cloudwatch_log_group.syncer: the log group's name is derived from the function name, so the graph orders the log group *after* the function. AWS's documented best practice is the opposite — the CloudWatch log group must exist before the Lambda function (aws_lambda_function depends_on aws_cloudwatch_log_group). Because nothing orders the log group before the function's first invocation (aws_s3_object.trigger invokes it later), Lambda can auto-create the log group first, causing Terraform to fail with "log group already exists" or to lose the configured retention_in_days/kms_key_id/log_group_class. aws_lambda_function.syncer should depend on aws_cloudwatch_log_group.syncer.
